assessments.name: Online Independent Learning Tasks
assessments.description: Complete four 1‑hour modules independently, each including a quiz task, with a focus on key topics such as assessment, working with factual texts, policy issues in English and literacy, and engagement and equity in the English classroom.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 01 Due date : 24 Jul 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 07 Aug 2026

assessments.name: Professional Practice Paper
assessments.description: In a small group, produce a professional practice paper on a chosen topic that connects theory and practice. The paper should draw on current research and key theoretical perspectives, while also providing practical classroom applications.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 03 Due date : 04 Aug 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 18 Aug 2026

assessments.name: Moderation and Planning for Literacy Learning
assessments.description: Moderate students' work, design a sequenced learning plan, and provide a rationale explaining how your differentiation supports diverse learners, aligns with English curriculum outcomes, and ensures connections between planning, teaching, and assessment.
assessments.dueRaw: Week 04 Due date : 11 Aug 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 25 Aug 2026
